text:
maya: Heads-up — I'm drafting the internal release note for the 2026-03 micro-release. Need quick alignment on version pinning and the internal blast copy. Pasting draft below, suggestions welcome.

maya: DRAFT RN snippet:
- What: small infra + model routing fix
- When: 2026-03-21 18:00 UTC (change window 18:00–19:00 UTC)
- Who is affected: Hosted API users on redwood-psi model family (no breaking API changes)
- Rollout: Canary -> Gradual 100% over 1h, fallback to redwood-psi-2.2 if issues
- Notes: pin hosted default to redwood-psi-2.3 for this rollout; customers on Dedicated unaffected by default

maya: Qs: can we pin hosted default to 2.3 today and set automatic fallback? Also need short internal announcement copy for #eng and ops.

alex: +1 on the RN draft. For pinning, we should use a soft pin (routing preference) rather than hard pin for 1h canary. That lets us rollback faster.

sam: Agree with soft pin. Canary plan: 5% traffic for first 10m, 25% next 15m, then 100% over remaining 35m if OK. Fallback route ready: `route set redwood-psi -> redwood-psi-2.2 --fallback redwood-psi-2.2`.

deploy-bot: Canary started: release/psi-2.3-canary @ 2026-03-21T18:00:12Z — targets: hosted-us-west1, hosted-eu-west1 — initial weight 5%. Monitor /deploy/status and /observability/latency.

jordan: Rollback triggers proposal:
- 3x baseline error rate for 3 consecutive minutes OR
- 30% increase in 95p latency sustained for 5 minutes OR
- Any user-facing regression flagged by Prod QA within canary window.
If any trigger hits, immediate rollback to 2.2 and alert oncall.

maya: Thanks — can we capture explicit SLO thresholds in the RN? I'll add the latency/error thresholds. Also, who owns standby during the canary?

alex: I'll take first 30m standby then handoff to jordan. I'll post a short checklist for ops.

alex: Ops checklist (internal):
1) Confirm canary traffic weight progression: 5% -> 25% -> 100%
2) Watch `inference.errors_total` and `inference.latency_p95` dashboards
3) If rollback: run `deploy rollback release/psi-2.3-canary --to release/psi-2.2` and notify #eng-oncall

eva: timezone note: 18:00 UTC is 19:00 CET, 11:00 PT — good for EU/NA overlap, avoids APAC late-night. Confirming we have oncall coverage in that window.

jordan: acked. I'll be on standby 18:30–20:00 UTC. Set @jordan as oncall mention in the RN.

maya: Internal announcement copy for #eng and #ops (short):
"Quick heads-up: rolling out redwood-psi-2.3 to hosted today 18:00 UTC. Canary -> full rollout over 1h. Soft-pin to 2.3; fallback to 2.2 if we hit rollback criteria. Standby: alex (first 30m) then jordan. See /deploy/status for live progress."

maya: Any wording tweaks?

sam: Suggest adding link to rollback playbook: <https://intra.redwood/ops/rollback-playbook>. Also add a short note: "No action required for Dedicated unless you override pin."

maya: Updated copy with playbook link and Dedicated note. Finalizing RN now. I'll publish the internal announcement after the first 10m canary check (unless we see anomalies).

deploy-bot: Canary weight updated: 25% @ 2026-03-21T18:10:45Z — health checks nominal.

alex: :thumbsup: I'll monitor the dashboards. If all green at 18:25 UTC, we merge soft-pin to default routing and publish RN in #eng-releases.

jordan: If anything odd, ping me with `@jordan escalate` and I'll trigger rollback.

maya: Great — thanks team. Publishing RN + soft-pin to default at ~18:30 if no flags.
